sc: Step-ladder fever for 2 weeks, relative bradycardia, coated tongue, soft spleen → Typhoid: blood culture
Typhoid in week 3 with sudden abdominal pain and rigidity → Ileal perforation: surgery
Prolonged fever, sweats, joint pain, raw goat milk → Brucellosis
f: Fever, headache, abdominal pain, constipation or diarrhoea · relative bradycardia · rose spots · splenomegaly · leucopenia
Blood culture (week 1) · bone marrow culture (most sensitive) · Widal is unreliable
Uncomplicated: azithromycin 20 mg/kg once daily × 7 days · severe: IV ceftriaxone 80 mg/kg/day
Week 3: ileal perforation, GI bleeding · encephalopathy · myocarditis · chronic carrier (gallbladder)
Fever, sweats, arthralgia, sacroiliitis, hepatosplenomegaly · agglutination ≥ 1:160 · death from endocarditis
Two drugs for 6 weeks: < 8 yr rifampicin + cotrimoxazole · ≥ 8 yr doxycycline + rifampicin
trap: Brucellosis with one drug or a short course relapses · doxycycline is avoided under 8 years · prevention: boil or pasteurise milk
